backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence describing updates to the Note screen message and adding a Propose Day illustration asset.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files including styles, Tailwind config, and main components.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes and applying background/foreground defaults.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component managing navigation flow between cover, note, question, and celebration screens with evasive No button logic.
Cover screen with floating hearts, teddy decorations, and a CTA button to open the note.
frontend/src/components/NehaNoteScreen.t: Note screen showing a romantic message, static Propose Day illustration, decorations, and a continue button.
frontend/src/components/TeddyDecor.tsx: Utility component rendering randomly placed floating teddy sticker images.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Hook and provider for managing Internet Identity login state, stored identities, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and defines extensive OKLCH-based light/dark theme CSS variables plus global base styles and imported fonts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loading global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, radii, shadows, and animations using the custom OKLCH CSS variables and plugins.
project_state.json: JSON file describing the project’s current requirements, features, design goals, and state metadata for the romantic interactive page.
